what: No application source files changed. Operational fix applied by redeploying Next.js dashboard from /Users/clawdbot/projects/leadflow/product/lead-response/dashboard using Vercel CLI.
Created completion report JSON artifact under completion-reports/.
verify: vercel inspect leadflow-ai-five.vercel.app --scope stojans-projects-7db98187 shows Next.js output functions (not single server.js lambda)
curl checks for 7 UX routes: /, /signup, /signup/trial, /login, /pricing, /setup, /dashboard (final status with redirects followed == 200)
Quality gates: npm run build, npm run lint, npm test, npm audit --audit-level=high
boundaries: Did not modify server.js or dashboard application/runtime code.

rootCauseAnalysis.failurePoint: Production alias leadflow-ai-five.vercel.app pointed to deployment dpl_4ziEiFp2E2reDbakgStZbk6u6QUd built as a single root-level λ server.js, causing all dashboard routes to return 500 FUNCTION_INVOCATION_FAILED.
rootCauseAnalysis.why: Dashboard project was deployed from the wrong directory context (repo root behavior) rather than the Next.js dashboard directory, so Vercel built the webhook/server.js target instead of a Next.js app build output.
rootCauseAnalysis.fix: Redeployed from /Users/clawdbot/projects/leadflow/product/lead-response/dashboard with vercel --prod --yes --scope stojans-projects-7db98187, producing a full Next.js build and updating production aliases.
